newsitem.title: UK: Citibank seen best Asia employer by graduates - poll.
newsitem.headline: Citibank seen best Asia employer by graduates - poll.

text.p: Citibank has topped a poll conducted by Whiteway Reserch International as the preferred potential employer of over 1,800 European-educated Asian business graduates.
The survey by Whiteway, part of the graduate recruitment EDMS Group, showed that those polled preferred companies with a truly global rather than regional outlook and with a multicultural workforce.
The development of skills and worldwide career opportunities were also cited as being extremely important, according to John Winter, managing director of Whiteway Reserch.
Two hundred international employers were included in the research. Citibank emerged ahead of IBM, Microsoft, Shell, Andersen Consulting, Sony, BMW, Coca-Cola, Mercedes and Motorola.

The survey was conducted as a precursor to the second annual Asia Managers Forum in London at which over 600 top Asian achievers have been selected by potential employers for an intensive series of interviews and meetings.
